page.layout: One printed page. Top: a woodcut ornamental border (not text). Below it, full-width headings: "RELIGIOSO LECTORI" and "SALUTEM." Then one text block of two-column-width running text with a large woodcut initial G at left; no margin notes; below the last line a signature mark "(:) ij" at centre-left.

main_text.l: nullum unquam vidi titulū qui mi-
rum. Quid illud esset quod hac ap-
mines istos praesertim qui de clero papali nil
hiscere solent mali, non potui certè non primo aspectu
mirari: penitius verò inquirens, interpretationem inveni quae
expectationi meae vocisque vi haud adeò congruere

page.notes: The large initial G is a woodcut initial in a framed box; read as G with [?] not needed. The catchword "gruere" is set at the right foot of the text block. Page has no page number or running head. The opening word is "GRAVIS" with the initial G joined to RAVIS, rendered as printed; "titulū" carries a macron over u as printed.
